title: Clear worker reference range
summary: Recover the worker reference range clear at 0x499710: release each non-null reference using its displacement-selected control block, then reset the range end to its current beginning.
test_description: Compare original and C++ on empty and mixed ranges, null entries, shared references, zero-count wraparound and a release callback that changes the beginning. Check release order, arguments, counts, FS head, range and untouched fields.
known_limits: Names and ownership of the underlying objects and displacement table remain unresolved.
Only valid 32-bit layouts and normal callbacks are tested; exception paths and invalid ranges are not modeled.
No claim is made about the incidental EAX return value of this void routine.
